title: 193 Countries Marble Survival 🌍 Round 1 · Heat 4/7 – Only 14 Survive
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 1 · Heat 4/7: 27 countries race through 3 stages — only 14 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Belgium, Belize, Benin, Botswana, Costa Rica, Croatia, Denmark, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Estonia, Finland, France, Ghana, Grenada, Guatemala, Guinea, Indonesia, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Kuwait, Malawi, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, South Sudan, Timor-Leste, Türkiye.

Next race: Round 1 · Heat 5/7. Grand Final: Nov 9.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. 3 new races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
